thread:
sasha: Heads-up — staging perf spike right after the model bump to checkpoint v2.1. p50 ~3x, KV-cache hit rate dropped ~35%. Canary stopped by rollout policy.
kevin: Any tokenizer changes in the checkpoint? or longer average seq lengths?
maria: Tokenizer looks identical in metadata, but I see more short->long token expansions in the payloads. Also ran a quick flamegraph. Hot path is in kernel selection falling back to the generic matmul. snippet:
```
kernel_selector::choose_matmul(size=2048) -> matmul_generic
latency_us = 1200 (hot)
previous: matmul_fast -> 420 us
```
jamie: That smells like the kernel-threshold tweak that landed in yesterday's runtime merge (PR 998). It adjusted threshold heuristics for matmul selection. Bisect incoming.
perf-ci: [alert] CI perf/regression detected: staging/decoder_p50 up 3.1x on job 1780001200. Full run: https://ci.internal/runs/1780001200 (perf diff attached).
sasha: Canary halted automatically, seeing increased queuing and higher CPU on host-3. KV cache miss spike correlates with the slow kernel.
kevin: Quick mitigation: we can force the old kernel via env override on the canary nodes: REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL=matmul_legacy then redeploy the pool. That should bring p50 back while we bisect.
maria: Test command I used to repro locally: 
```bash
python -m benchmarks.decode --model ./checkpoints/v2.1 --seq 2048 --profile
```
produces the flamegraph at /tmp/fg.svg — shows the selector falling through.
jamie: I'm running a git bisect over merges from last 24h now. Initial guess: runtime/heuristics commit 6a7f changed the size buckets.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused: policy=perf-slo, reason=decoder_p50 > threshold
perf-ci: Reproduced on CI: the regression is present when kernel_selector uses new rules + checkpoint v2.1 tokenizer expansion.
kevin: If revert needed, I'll prep the revert PR for the heuristics change. Alternatively we can patch selector to treat this checkpoint as legacy (temporary).
sasha: Let's do this order: 1) force REDWOOD_FORCE_KERNEL on canary to unblock customers, 2) jamie's bisect to find exact commit, 3) revert or patch + run onboarding perf suite (tokenizer-length histogram, kvcache-stress).
maria: Added a quick smoke to onboarding tests to check avg tokenized length and KV cache hit-rate after load. Will push in a follow-up.
jamie: Bisect found the culprit: commit 6a7f99d (runtime: adjust matmul bucket thresholds). Opening revert PR #1008 now.
kevin: Revert PR looks good, running CI. If CI green I'll roll it to canary after we remove the env override.
sasha: Thanks everyone. Keep perf-ci notified and ping if rollback blocks anything. :thumbsup:
kevin: I'll leave the force-kernel override on until revert is live.
maria: I'll re-run the profiler once revert is deployed to confirm KV hit-rate recovers.
jamie: PR merged and promoted to canary, deploy started.
sasha: Observability shows p50 back down to baseline after rollout. Closing the thread, will follow up with postmortem about tokenizer-length guardrails.
